sub_answers.text: By 1993, Thesz’s enthusiasm for the UWFi waned as the company started moving away from its shootfighting style and favoring performers over wrestlers, and he severed relations with the company. [d668815s10p0] He took his old championship belt back with him after ending his relationship with UWFi. [d668815s10p0] He became commissioner and occasional trainer for UWFi, teaching wrestlers techniques in catch wrestling during a week each month in Japan, but later left due to the company’s change in direction. [d668815s10p0]
